text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear three-part structure with \"Firstly,\" \"Second reason,\" \"Finally,\" and a conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents its reasons in a deliberate sequence that is easy to follow from introduction to conclusion."},{"evidence":"uses article-based examples like work zones, sensors, and liability laws","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay supports its claim with multiple details drawn from the source instead of relying mainly on personal opinion."},{"evidence":"each body paragraph centers on a different concern: safety, malfunction, laws","quality":"reasoning development","description":"The essay develops distinct arguments and explains how each one leads to the conclusion that driverless cars are unsafe."},{"evidence":"repeats and reinforces the claim that driverless cars are unsafe throughout","quality":"claim consistency","description":"The essay stays focused on a single argumentative position and connects each paragraph back to that position."},{"evidence":"concluding summary restates all three reasons against driverless cars","quality":"conclusion","description":"The ending briefly synthesizes the main points rather than stopping after the last body paragraph."}]}
